artboards.title: Diagram — drag and drop, live cursors

annotations.text:
Fathom — rebuilt UI, first pass

Built on the real tokens in design/tokens.css: no rounded corners, no shadows, 1px hairlines, the small type ramp, tabular numerals. The three risk colours are used only for risk.

Static mockups — nothing is clickable. They exist to settle layout and density before React.

Open questions these raise:

1. Is the left palette the right way to add devices, or should it be a search-and-place command?

2. The diagram shows presence avatars top-right and cursors on canvas. Enough, or do you want a participant list?

3. The config checker tone is explanatory, not pass/fail. Is that the teaching voice you want?
